title: [Toyota Times] FY2027 2Q Results: First Profit Growth in 3 Years Set to Fuel Business Reforms
summary: Toyota announced its Q2 FY2027 financial results. Despite challenges in the Middle East and a changing external environment, sustained improvement efforts delivered the first profit increase in three years. Toyota Times highlights the key takeaways! #TOYOTATIMES
